items.title: India's interest rate gap with G7 in focus as RBI weighs inflation risks: Report
items.summary: The report highlighted the importance of maintaining a certain difference between Indian and G7 interest rates to attract foreign debt capital, particularly as the US Federal Reserve is expected to continue its rate-hiking cycle

items.title: Gold drops over 1% as oil rally reinforces higher-for-longer rate outlook
items.summary: Gold fell more ‌than 1% on Thursday as rising oil prices stoked inflation concerns and reinforced expectations that interest rates could stay higher for longer, while investors awaited next week's Federal Reserve meeting for clues ​on the policy outlook.

items.title: Gold eases as investors await Fed signals on rate path
items.summary: Gold prices saw a decline as investors shift attention to the looming Federal Reserve policy meeting regarding interest rates. Spot gold prices dipped to $4,115.50 per ounce, with US gold futures for December slipping to $4,132.30. Analysts anticipate potential rate hikes in the coming months, particularly in December, where the likelihood stands at 90%. Other precious metals like silver and platinum also noted price drops.

items.title: Gold Edges Lower as Traders Weigh Middle East Signals, Fed Rate Path
items.summary: Gold dipped as a flareup in Middle East hostilities raised inflation risks, even as the Federal Reserve is still expected to keep interest rates steady in the near term.

items.title: Gold dips for fourth session as oil rally fans inflation concerns
items.summary: GOLD eased for a fourth session on Wednesday as higher oil prices stoked inflationary concerns, while investors looked ahead to next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting for clues on the future path of interest rates.

items.title: Gold prices near Rs 1.47 lakh/10 grams, silver falls by Rs 1,144/kg as traders await Fed rate signals. What lies ahead?
items.summary: Gold prices edged lower while silver fell on MCX as investors awaited the US Federal Reserves upcoming policy decision for clues on interest rates. Traders expect rates to remain unchanged in October, with a possible hike in December. Analysts say dollar strength may cap golds upside, while central bank buying supports longer-term prices.

items.title: Gold slips as investors await Fed rate signals
items.summary: Gold prices fell slightly as investors monitored the Federal Reserve's major interest rate decision. The anticipated meeting will provide key insights into future economic policies. Economists expect the Fed to hold rates steady, emphasizing inflation concerns. The Bank of Japan is also projected to raise interest rates in December. Other precious metals, including silver and platinum, experienced minimal changes during this period.

items.title: Commodity Corner: Oil prices edge higher on Middle East supply risks; gold holds decline
items.summary: Gold held a decline as conflicting signals on efforts to end the Iran war clouded the outlook for inflation and the Federal Reserve’s path for interest rates.
